# Contributing

Rapier is an offline Markdown editor licensed AGPL-3.0-only. See [commercial licensing](../docs/LICENSING.md).

- Open an issue with steps to reproduce a bug or a proposed feature.
- Share only files and details you are comfortable making public.
- Link pull requests to an issue. Maintainers review, test, and integrate accepted changes.
- Sign the [Contributor License Agreement](../docs/CLA.md) when prompted; you keep your copyright.
- Include a regression test that fails before the fix and passes after.
- Preserve offline editing and exact Markdown source outside the edited range.

For agent integrations, see the [MCP endpoint](https://mcp.rapier.website/mcp), [skills](../plugin/skills/), and [llms.txt](../site/llms.txt).
